items.title: Lemon Nash Interview, 1959-10-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...What's your name? Bill Russell, what is your full name? Lemon Nash.

ctx.x: Okay, Bill, do you want to talk a little? You're going to be quiet. I'll keep quiet. I'm over here. What's your name? Bill Russell, what is your full name? Lemon Nash.
Do you have any middle name? No, just Lemon Nash.
